header.label: Comparison
header.title: OpenAEC Open Speech Studio vs Dragon
header.desc: Open Speech Studio is a free, open source alternative to Dragon NaturallySpeaking. Compare speech recognition, dictation, languages, platforms and privacy — factual and balanced.

summary.p1: Dragon NaturallySpeaking (Nuance, part of Microsoft since 2022) has been the established standard for desktop speech-to-text for decades. Dragon Professional typically costs €500-700 one-time, and there is a subscription variant (Dragon Anywhere) at around €15-20 per month. The software runs on Windows only, processes audio 100% locally, and has a strong reputation for dictation accuracy and industry-specific vocabularies (medical, legal).
summary.p2: Open Speech Studio from the OpenAEC Foundation is a free, open source speech recognition application built on Whisper AI from OpenAI. It runs cross-platform (Windows, macOS, Linux), processes audio 100% locally, and supports 99 languages out-of-the-box. License: LGPL-3.0. No subscription, no telemetry, no vendor lock-in.
summary.p3: Honest positioning: Dragon has decades of experience with dictation accuracy and industry-specific vocabularies (medical, legal) and extensive voice profile training. Open Speech Studio uses state-of-the-art Whisper AI, which performs excellently for general dictation, but is a younger project without the specialized industry dictionaries Dragon has built up over decades.

openaec.title: Choose Open Speech Studio if...
openaec.li1: You don't want to pay €500-700 and don't want a subscription either.
openaec.li2: You work on macOS or Linux (Dragon is Windows-only).
openaec.li3: You need multiple languages — Whisper supports 99 languages out-of-the-box.
openaec.li4: You don't want vendor lock-in and want to be able to inspect the source code.
openaec.li5: You value transparency and want to support open source.
openaec.li6: You already use other OpenAEC tools and want integrated workflows.
openaec.li7: You value privacy and data sovereignty — everything runs locally, no telemetry.

dragon.title: Choose Dragon NaturallySpeaking if...
dragon.li1: You need advanced voice profile training for maximum personal accuracy.
dragon.li2: You work in a specific field with extensive vocabularies (medical, legal) that Dragon has spent decades optimizing for.
dragon.li3: You need 24/7 enterprise support with an SLA.
dragon.li4: You have legacy Dragon macros you don't want to lose that are deeply embedded in your workflow.
dragon.li5: You work exclusively on Windows and the license cost isn't an issue.
dragon.li6: You need commercial vendor accountability for compliance reasons.

cta.title: Try Open Speech Studio for free
cta.desc: Download for Windows, macOS or Linux and experience Whisper AI speech recognition in 99 languages — local, private and without a subscription. No registration, no account, no telemetry.
